reviewer: chatgpt:Codex direct review with Astra visual review

findings.description: Direct inspection of front, arm-cross, crouch and sit renders: the shorts hem is visible in neutral but both gray thighs break through the white shorts coverage up to the hips in crouch and sit. A narrow white strip remains between the thighs in neutral. The intended under-short layer does not retain hip-flexion coverage.

Direct inspection of back, three-quarter, crouch, sit and prone renders: the rear overskirt still forms two long, sharply pointed strips beneath the seat in crouch and sit. The panels collapse into angular tails instead of controlled pleats; the shorter/narrower V9 trial did not resolve this defect.

Direct inspection of front, side, neutral, arms-up and arm-cross renders: broad faceted wrinkles and pinched folds persist around sleeves, underarms and jacket waist. The surface does not read as a finished smooth fencing jacket.

The diagonal lilac placket and button-like details are visible, but the prototype construction declares the closure unfastened and no retained fastening is demonstrated. Do not infer closure security or fit from the render.

nextAction: Keep V9 rejected and release blocked. For a new revision, redesign shorts hip-flexion coverage and remove unsupported pointed rear tails with an explicit controlled pleat/support topology; correct jacket surface folds and implement a retained closure. Re-render and directly inspect the affected views and poses. UV remains NOT_CREATED; fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat runtime, package and release remain UNVERIFIED.
